subject: Re: Kickoff: AndroidInteraction — when should an agent ask the user?
body:
Ulla,

Staffing: Csilla leads at 60%, Rosa 50% on ingest and the classifier, Wei 25% advisory on the message-generation side, Maren 20% on pipeline support.

Compute: light. 16 A100s best-effort covers classifier training — 3,605 annotated steps is a small supervised problem; the expensive part is decoding the GZIP TFRecords with PNG screenshot payloads.

On the platform dependency: We're planning around the Corpus v2 migration freeze on 2026-08-07, which gives us room to land the ingest before anything locks down. Rosa has the ingest scheduled for early July on that basis, so we're not squeezed.

Daniela
